findings.label: Route string drift
findings.description: HomeNavigation.kt uses raw string literals for navigation targets instead of DevOSRoutes constants. Routes 'notifications', 'profile', 'project_list', 'repository/import' already have DevOSRoutes equivalents; a constant rename silently breaks navigation without a compile error.
findings.action: Replace raw string literals in HomeNavigation.kt with DevOSRoutes.* references where constants exist.

findings.label: Duplicate nav target for Sessions
findings.description: NavigateToAllSessions and NavigateToChat(sessionId) both navigate to 'ai_chat' with no session ID argument in either case. When a real ai_chat/{sessionId} route lands in DEVOS-058, both call sites need updating; having them identical risks the NavigateToAllSessions case being forgotten.
findings.action: Track both call sites in DEVOS-058. Separate them before the route gains a sessionId parameter.

findings.label: Avatar touch target below 48dp
findings.description: The profile avatar Box is DevOSSpacing.iconSizeLarge (32dp) with a bare Modifier.clickable — confirmed below the 48dp WCAG/DevOS accessibility minimum touch target.
findings.action: Wrap the avatar Box in an IconButton or expand its effective clickable area to DevOSSpacing.touchTarget (48dp).

findings.label: Missing Compose UI tests
findings.description: No @Composable UI test exists for HomeScreen. The arch standard requires one per screen; 9 ViewModel unit tests pass but the screen's 4 UI states are not exercised via ComposeTestRule.
findings.action: Add a HomeScreenTest before DEVOS-058 ships the screen with real data.
